1.4Location
The overall dimensions of the machine depend on the type of dosing system added to
the machine, whether there is a zipper applicator, straw insertion system; spout cap
insertion system etc. added to the machine. It also depends on the conveyor belt that
comes connected to the machine and if the machine forms part of a line of machinery.
The positioning should be realised leaving between 1 and 1,5 metres of free space
around the machine. At the right side of the machine, this distance has to be as long as
the walking beam as a minimum, due to the walking beam maintenance operations.

1.6Inert gas installation (optional)

The inert gas injected in the funnels/nozzles, hopper and horizontal feeder of the
Mespack Packaging machines is supplied with all the connections and prepared from
factory. In the gas feeding valve of the Mespack filler there is prepared a connection
to pre-inject of gas the customer product hopper.
Mespack recommends to seal 1 fitting connection of gas for each 4 liters of product
(along the hopper and the product inlet).

2 STORAGE
2.1Conditions for a long period storage
The packaging machine must be stored in a dust free and protected site at a
maximum temperature of 25°C, and a specific humidity not exceeding 55-60%. This is
especially important to prevent the machine deterioration.

1 INTRODUCTION
1.1 Model
AT series Cap applicator:

Applicator model: ATE-920 D

Applicator number: 921.022

Machine mode: H-270 FE

Serial number: 272.006

Delivery data: APRIL 2019

IMPORTANT:
When making a technical enquiry or ordering spare parts could customers please include
the above serial number (it coincides with the license plate serial number which is located
on the left side of the main machine). In this way, you will help us to speed up operations
and ensure accuracy and prompt delivery of spare parts.

2/30

A.T.E.

1.2 Introduction
The instructions contained in this manual apply to all the types of cap applicator model
the customer may have. All the different adjustments and units have the same
functioning. The only difference between one cap applicator and another is the number
of caps introduced in the pouch, which depends solely on the on the type of host machine
the customer has purchased.
This manual gives a detailed summary of essential information for commissioning and the
proper functioning of cap applicators.
These servicing instructions are especially addressed to technical personnel and the
applicator operator. We strongly recommend that they carefully read these instructions
despite any prior experience and knowledge they may have of this type of machinery.
We would also like to point out that it is not possible to write down instructions for all
possible inconveniences or unexpected occurrences that may arise whilst using the
applicator. The most important thing above all is careful observation, common sense and
calm and patience on the part of the machinery operator.
The proper functioning of an applicator primarily depends on careful use and
maintenance by the machine operator.
Careful cleaning and maintenance will significantly prolong applicator lifespan.

3/30

A.T.E.

2 TECHNICAL CHARACTERISTICS
2.1 General data
The latest generation EDGE CAP APPLICATOR incorporates state of the art technology
whilst guaranteeing very high efficiency and quality.
This unit, as its name indicates positions and seals the edge cap on the pouch after it has
been properly folded, sealed and perforated. This completes the pouch forming process
prior to filling.
The edge cap applicator can produce both SIMPLE and DUPLEX pouches:

SIMPLE A.T.E. (920.000)
DUPLEX A.T.E.D. (921.000)
The difference between a machine that produces simple pouches to one that produces
duplex pouches is that the former forms one pouch per movement whereas the duplex
forming machine produces two pouches per movement. It effectively doubles production
but reduces the size of the pouch it produces.
The edge cap is designed to be placed on the upper edge of the pouch. A cut is made on
one of the edges at a 45º angle leaving a slanted base so that the cap can be attached
onto the pouch by means of sealers.

3 SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS

WARNING
These are safety instructions for the cap applicator only. Please
refer to main manual safety instructions to service any part not
belonging to the cap applicator.

3.1 Hazards
In matters of safety MESPACK has followed all EU safety guidelines in order to guarantee
the safety of the personnel servicing the HORIZONTAL MACHINE and the Cap applicator
as well as machine maintenance. These regulations are detailed in the EEC Declaration of
conformity of the HORIZONTAL MACHINE Instructions Manual.
All these regulations are basically intended to avoid contact with the machine, and
address functional aspects and basic design principles.
The main hazards that a worker in charge of operating this Cap applicator may be
exposed to are of various levels of danger.

Mechanical hazards
Our machines basically operate based on mechanics, with continuous
oscillating movements in most of the units involved in folding,
manufacturing, filling, dragging and cutting the sachets. The hazards
involved here are cutting or slicing, dragging or getting stuck and even
being hit by protruding mobile units.

Electrical hazards
Our machines come equipped with an electrical parts cabinet which
houses the generators and power distributors. Non-experienced
personnel must not touch the machine's electrical and electronic
components. In addition, other machine parts may have accidently been
charged due to short-circuit or overloads.

Burn hazards
Our machines work at high temperatures, which may reach 180ºC in
heat sealers zone. In case of needing to manipulate the sealers make
sure they have cooled down before.

7/30

A.T.E.

3.2 Safety measures
The cap applicator is equipped with the necessary and sufficient safety mechanisms to
protect the operator from all the hazards specified above.
See RNA-VIBRANT Operating instructions provided with the instructions manual for
further information.

WARNING
Read carefully safety instructions in RNA-VIBRANT operating
instruction manual provided to reduce the risk of serious
personal injury.
Read carefully safety instructions in HORIZONTAL MACHINE
instruction manual to reduce the risk of serious personal injury.

Maintenance
While performing maintenance and reparation of the machine, the electrical feeding of
the machine should be disconnected by switching the main power switch that can be
found on the control panel inside the electrical cabinet. The air pressure valve, situated in
the feeding unit in the right lateral of the machine should be closed, passing from “open”
to “exh”.
For the ATE, there is an independent compressed air connection to feed the applicator. It
is also necessary to close it during maintenance work.
The main power switch of the cap feeder is located in the feeder electrical cabinet.
The main power switch of the elevator feeder caps (optional) is located of the feeder
electrical cabinet.

maintenance or repairs. Risk of electric shock.

Lockout procedure
The lockout procedure will protect operator of sudden machine start while performing
maintenance on equipment. It is necessary to perform lockout procedure correctly and
operators must be properly trained.
Previous to open fixed guards, follow the lockout procedure:

• Machine must be stopped.
• Go to the side of the electrical cabinet.
• Turn lockout switch to 0/OFF position.
• Install the padlock, close and keep the key under supervision.
• Machine can be manipulated be in a secure way.

Engage procedure:
• Verify that all back- guards are prperly closed and no operators are manipulating
machine.
• Remove padlock from lockout switch.
• Turn lockout switch to 1/ON position.
• Reset machine.
• Machine is ready.

Distribution of groups
The AT cap applicator is made up of various units:

Most cap applicator units can be adjusted to accommodate format changeovers or to
adjust vibrations.
When we talk about format changeover we are referring to changes in width size, never
to height changes because the height of the upper edge of the film never varies.

4.1 Cap elevator (optional)
The cap elevator unit is optional. It is not an essential part of the applicator.
The elevator conveys the caps from the cap container which is at a lower level, to the cap
hopper on a conveyor belt with scoops.
The hopper holds 150 liters.
The cap elevator unit does not require adjustment for format changeover.

4.2 Cap distributor (Only duplex version)
The cap distributor unit is an optional attachment for the cap elevator. This unit is
provided when the elevator comes along with a duplex cap applicator. The duplex cap
applicator has two hoppers. The cap distributor distributes caps coming from the elevator
to both hoppers.
The cap elevator unit does not require adjustment for format changeover.

Cap elevator and cap distributor (optional)

A.T.E.

4.3 Cap feeder
This unit feeds the caps by means of a hopper “A”, to the position on the pouch along
specially designed leads ”B”.
The unit is equipped with an adjustable support table “C”.
The unit requires the following adjustments:
• Pneumatic adjustments (to increase or decrease vibration) depending on whether
the caps move too quickly or block up the vibrating lead. Air flow can be increased
or lowered by adjusting the pressure adapters “D”. 4 bars is appropriate pressure.
• Format changeover for pouch width. The unit comes equipped with a lead on
which the hoppers rest. Starting from flywheel “E” the vibrator and the lead move
along until the cap is placed in the right position where the cap inserter unit
deposits the cap on the pouch. Before this happens, lever “F” is loosened under
the feeder support and the unit comes back into place after it has been
positioned.

The cap inserter drive is the device that comes after the cap feeder unit. It is equipped
with cap leads and it immediately grips the cap and places it in the right position for

This unit requires a number of adjustments during pouch format changeover.

Procedure:
Adjust the cap inserter unit position with regard to the cap position the same as for the
feeder unit. Both units require the same adjustment because they are connected by the
cap leads. To adjust the position of this unit simply loosen the adjustable handle “A”
which is attached to the unit on the leads on top of the machine bed.
The group also requires horizontal adjustment for minor adjustments, in order to ensure
that the edge cap is properly positioned. In the picture, we can see the grippers stand “B”
that is attached to lead “C”. By loosening the fastening screw, we can move the cap
grippers sideways until we achieve perfect edge cap sealing.
It is important to adjust the unit cylinders. The unit is equipped with 4 cylinders “D”. For
the grippers, for the cap grip valve, for the cap lead stop and the cap valve stop. These
allow us to adjust the amount of air and the pressure of air entering into the cylinder.
The unit also allows us to finely adjust the grippers and the cap grip valve by moving the
guide slots “E”.
By moving the guide slots up or down a few millimeters we can adjust the cap position
and ensure proper sealing.

You can also adjust the drive to adjust the amount of vertical movement of the cap
inserter unit. This unit performs the movement that moves the cap from the cap grip
valve onto the pouch edge.

The drive enables us to adjust the level of movement adjustment levels at three different
points.
Adjustment at the lever guide slot “A”. By loosening the fastening nut and moving the rod
sideways.
Adjust the nut “B” on the ball and joint socket of the rod and extend or shorten the rod.
It is important to keep in mind that these two adjustments vary the gripper height. To
bring it in line loosen the screws “C” which fasten the support of the shafts “D” which give
movement to the grippers.
It is important to keep the following in mind: The longer the rod the higher the gripper
position. And the greater the adjustment of the guide slot the shorter the course of the
grippers.

Sealing pressure
The sealing pressure always remains constant during while machine is running but
can be adjusted.
o When sealing pressure is exerted by a spring, sealing pressure can be
adjusted modifying spring compression.

The sealer pressure is correct when rod length equals to 331 mm and
distance between guide and housing is between +2 and +3 mm, during the

o When sealing pressure is exerted by a pneumatic cylinder, sealing pressure
can be adjusted through the air gauge. IMPORTANT: optionally, the sealers

4.8 Cap applicator pouch opener
The pouch opener unit of the cap applicator ensures that the pouch remains open once
the cap has been sealed.
This unit requires adjustment for width format changeover. The system is activated by the
“STATIC STRETCH” unit of the base machine. Every time it is activated the stretch
function operates on the cap applicator pouch opener.
There are two types of adjustments according to new pouch width:
1. Opening stroke.
It is adjusted by moving the rod. Procedure:
“B” along the lead supports “A”, to produce pouch aperture with the grippers “C”.
2. Grippers position.
Procedure: place the grippers “C” 3mm away from the edge of the new format
pouch and make sure they hold the pouch properly. Simply loosen the fastening
screw of the gripper “C” and move it along the lead of the lead support.

A number of explanations and adjustments are required in order to properly operate the
edge cap applicator Touch Screen.
This unit is not included in the touch screen description because it is a non-standard unit.

4.10 Cap presence detection
The machine has a presence detector located in the cap cooling area.
When no cap is detected, the machine doesn’t fill with product and pouch will be
rejected.
The consecutive number of rejected pouches without cap before the machine stops is
specified by the PLC.

5 MAINTENANCE
This chapter presents an EDGE CAP APPLICATOR maintenance program for LATEST
GENERATION MESPACK MACHINERY. This program should be adhered to in order to
ensure proper functioning and work application.

WARNING
Read carefully safety instructions in RNA-VIBRANT operating
instruction manual provided to reduce the risk of serious
personal injury.
Read carefully safety instructions in HORIZONTAL MACHINE
instruction manual to reduce the risk of serious personal injury.
For this handbook the times have been calculated for an 8 hours working day (Monday to
Friday) and for a single shift.

5.1 Maintenance program

DANGER
Make sure horizontal machine and the RNA-VIBRANT
equipment are OFF prior to any adjustment operation. Risk of
serious personal injury.

Mechanical maintenance
8 working hours maintenance
• Check the feeder case both on the inside and the outside for signs of rust, dents or
cracks.
• Check that the applicator is in good working order (general overhaul).
• Check for proper cap sealing after every so many pouches or operating hours. If
there are any irregularities pinpoint the problem and correct it promptly.
• Proceed to clean the machine and the work area at the end of every day’s work or
of every shift. We recommend you use compressed air to remove dust and
residues from the machine.
• Clean the cap sealing rods every 8 to 16 hours with a metal brush to get rid of any
traces of polyethylene. Check regularly whilst in operation. Cleaning must be
carried out only when sealers are cold.

25/30

A.T.E.

DANGER
Wear heat-resistant gloves to avoid risk of severe burns.

• Check that the operating pressure is between 4 and 6 bars or at 80 psi. If this is not
the case adjust the feeder unit manometer on both the main machine and the cap
feeder.

40 working hours maintenance
• Check the lubrication of cap inserter drive shafts. The oil comes from the central
lubricator.
• Grease the edge cap pouch opener unit guides.
• Check the cap insertion grippers.

520 working hours maintenance
• Check the pneumatic cylinders and compressed air system

1040 working hours maintenance
• Check the entire cap applicator.
• Check the cap sealers.

2080 working hours maintenance
• Check that all the screws and bolts on the edge cap feeder unit are properly
fastened. If any of them are loose replace the rounded bolts. Use appropriate
tools to tighten the allen and hexagonal screws.
• Check the state of all applicator components, i.e. springs, tensors, cams, etc. If any
of these are not in proper working order ask for them to be repaired.

6 TROUBLESHOOTING
What follows is a list of the most common complications that may arise, their possible
causes and solutions:

CAP OUT OF POSITION
The cap may end up in the wrong position after being sealed on the pouch for various
reasons:
o The cap positioning valve is in the wrong position.
o Stop plate is in wrong position.
o The insertion gripper does not grip the cap properly.
o Adjusting the different parts usually solves the problem of caps out of position.

AN IMPROPERLY SEALED CAP
The cap may be improperly sealed on the pouch for various reasons:
o Too little or too much pressure on the edge cap sealing cylinders.
o Excessive temperature or lack of temperature on the edge cap sealers.
o A cap out of position.
o Not enough apertures on the pouch for the cap to be properly positioned.
o When the cap is improperly sealed simply adjust edge cap sealer pressure by
regulating the air pressure.
o If the temperature is too high or too low, go to the edge cap MENU on the TOUCH
SCREEN and increase or lower the temperature volume.
o If the cap is improperly positioned on the sealing position read the previous
section “a) CAP OUT OF POSITION”.

NO CAP
The cap may not reach the sealing position for a number of reasons:
o A jammed feeder.
o A jam in the step to step process (cap leads).
o The insertion gripper does not pick up the cap.
o When the cap does not reach its destination you must check to make sure that
there are no caps in the wrong place on the lead.

28/30

A.T.E.

o Also check for obstructions on the feeder lead and make sure that the vibration
produced by the feeder is strong enough to move the caps along the lead.
o If the insertion gripper does not pick up the cap this means that the cap is not
reaching its final position or that the stop is simply in the wrong place and does
not stop the cap so that it can be picked up by the insertion gripper.
o The gripper may also not be functioning properly.

BADLY CUT FILM
The film may be badly cut due to a number of reasons:
• Die cutter wear.
o The die cutter has not been properly adjusted to the format.
o Lack of die cutter piston pressure.
o If the punch or the die cutter is worn, then the customer must order the
necessary spare parts.
o A wrongly adjusted die cutter will produce a faulty cut in relation to the cap
position on the pouch.
o If there is not enough pressure in the piston this can be set right by moving
the adjustment nut or the main pressure adjustment feeder.

29/30
